title: Blockchain Developer
description: Learn cryptographic consensus. Build Solidity smart contracts, deploy decentralized apps (DApps), and audit security frameworks.

nodes.title: Solidity Smart Contracts
nodes.description: Understand compilation, variables scoping, EVM memory vs storage, mapping indices, events, and modifiers.
projectIdeas: Build a verified voting smart contract allowing registered nodes to cast cryptographic votes.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between memory and storage variables in Solidity?
Explain smart contract re-entrancy bugs and how checks-effects-interactions prevents them.

nodes.title: Web3 APIs & Frontends (ethers.js)
nodes.description: Connect frontends with smart contracts. Master RPC node queries, wallet handshakes (MetaMask), and transactions signing.
projectIdeas: Build a token staking page dashboard that displays stake balances and triggers transactions signing via MetaMask.
interviewQuestions: What does an RPC Node provider do in decentralized app connections?
